The '''Heroes' Guild''' is located just south of [[Burthorpe]]. The guild is only accessible to [[members]] who have completed the [[Heroes' Quest]]. [[Dragon mace]]s and [[dragon battleaxe]]s can be purchased here, and [[amulets of glory]] can be recharged at the [[Fountain of Heroes|fountain]] in the basement of the guild.

{{Clear|left}}
==Transportation==

* The [[Portal of Heroes]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the [[Myths' Guild]] can be used to teleport outside the front door of the Heroes' Guild.
* The [[Teleport to House]] spell (if the [[player-owned house]] is in Taverley), or a redirected [[Taverley teleport]] tablet.
* A [[games necklace]] or [[Minigame Teleport]] to the [[Burthorpe Games Room]].
* A [[combat bracelet]] can be used to teleport to the [[Warriors' Guild]], north of the Heroes' Guild.

=={{FloorNumber|uk=1|caps=y|nohelp=y}}==
The {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} has a [[Prayer]] altar (dedicated to [[Saradomin]]). [[Helemos]]'s shop, the [[Happy Heroes' H'emporium|"Happy Heroes' H'emporium"]], is here, which sells the [[dragon battleaxe]] for 200,000 [[coins]] and the [[dragon mace]] for 50,000 [[coins]].

=={{FloorNumber|uk=2|caps=y|nohelp=y}}==
The {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the Heroes' Guild has a table with six chairs around it and a pair of empty chests.

==Basement==
The Heroes' Guild basement is accessed via a ladder on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} and is a miniature dungeon. It contains 2 monsters - 5 [[giant bat]]s, as well as a caged [[blue dragon]] that is good for training [[Ranged]], [[Magic]], or even [[Melee]] with a [[halberd]].
The [[Heroes' Guild mine]] is in the basement, too, with several rocks for higher level [[Mining|miners]]. There are:

*11 [[coal rocks]]
*2 [[mithril rocks]]
*2 [[adamantite rocks]]
*2 [[runite rocks]]

These are all arranged along the cavernous walls to the east side of the dungeon.

The [[Fountain of Heroes]] is in a small side passage off the dungeon. If an [[amulet of glory]] is dipped in the fountain, it will be recharged to four teleports.

The fountain used to be located on the ground floor, but when the [[Burthorpe Games Room]] was introduced along with its associated teleport via the [[games necklace]], it was moved downstairs to the basement. A shortcut is available to those who have both 67 Agility and have completed the hard [[Falador Diary]], which leads directly from the basement entrance to the Fountain of Heroes.
